method: Authorized AppleScript/System Events selected each effect while reference decks stayed paused. Read visible advanced strip. Local screenshots OCR transcribed; no vendor assets copied to repository. Restored slot1 LPF afterward.
evidence_limit: Observed labels and session values only. Not factory defaults, ranges, enum catalog, reachable state completeness or sonic equivalence. Eighteen OCR omissions manually resolved from screenshots; other session values remain OCR transcriptions.
